name: Divine Power
source:
MC is a Special Forces Soldier in this story. He went on a mission to a country called Roxania and something went wrong.
He found himself under an undesirable responsibility in a apocalypse scenario... also surrounded by hot chicks!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/xhaust]Patreon[/url]]

他发现自己在世界末日的场景中承担着不受欢迎的责任……而且周围都是辣妹！
